kind: controlled source ablation, not historical release comparison

clocks.engine: std.time.nanoTimestamp difference (wall CLOCK_REALTIME), no clock correction assumed during short pairs

timing: standalone driver nanosecond timer around git.request after JSON parse and before serialization; fresh Repository + arena each request. Kernels separately labelled. All raw samples retained.

results.name: decoded-object-cache
results.mechanism: Remember decoded immutable objects under OID and pack-offset keys; re-use parent/tree/delta bases within a request.

results.name: lazy-index-load
results.mechanism: Load and SHA-check pack indexes once per Repository instead of on every packed-object lookup.

results.name: binary-index-search
results.mechanism: Use first-byte fanout and binary search instead of scanning the complete sorted object-ID table.

results.name: fanout-bounds
results.mechanism: Use first OID byte to bound binary search to its 1/256 index bucket instead of searching the complete table.

results.name: cheap-filters-first
results.mechanism: Reject by timestamp/message/author before loading current and parent path trees.

results.name: stop-at-result-limit
results.mechanism: Stop traversal once 20 matching records exist instead of scanning the remaining 430-commit first-parent history.

results.name: stream-packed-objects
results.mechanism: Seek to object offset and let buffered zlib decode only that stream instead of reading the entire pack into each object call.
results.workload: Three packed commit records at pinned first-parent ancestor20, including any delta bases. Same object checksums and output.

results.name: delta-output-preallocation
results.mechanism: Read delta target length and reserve output capacity once, avoiding successive reallocations and copies.
results.workload: 1MiB base and target, 64 indexed 16KiB copy operations; includes allocation, delta application and equality check.

results.name: incremental-object-hash
results.mechanism: Feed kind/size/NUL/body incrementally to SHA-1 instead of constructing an extra full header-plus-body buffer.
results.workload: SHA-1 over blob 1048576 NUL plus 1MiB body; allocation and copy included in concatenate baseline.

results.name: fast-write-compression-kernel
results.mechanism: Zig .fast is deflate level 4 (shorter match search), while .default is level 6. Trade compression work against encoded bytes.
results.workload: Compress 1MiB repeated realistic source phrase, output allocated in arena. Excludes filesystem and fsync.

results.name: fast-write-compression-end-to-end
results.mechanism: Reduce zlib search level from default6 to fast4; measure full immutable-object write including fsync.
results.workload: 1MiB text fixture, OS cache warm, target object removed before each timed request. Timer excludes test setup and JSON parse.

results.name: existing-object-write-reuse
results.mechanism: If the content-addressed object exists, read and verify it instead of compressing, syncing and renaming another copy.
results.workload: Same1MiB body. Before removes target before each request. After keeps identical valid object; both compute the requested object SHA first.
